raw_responses.Bulgarian: DESCRIPTION: This line chart illustrates the massive activation of baseline across different layers, comparing four data series: attn_output, attn_residual, ffn_output, and ffn_residual. The y-axis, labeled "Max Activation Value," has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1600, with no units specified and evenly spaced intervals of 200. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," has a linear scale from 0 to 22, with no units specified and intervals of 5. The chart features four lines: attn_output (blue dashed), attn_residual (orange dotted), ffn_output (green dashed-dot), and ffn_residual (red solid). Initially, all lines start near 0, then sharply increase around layer 4. The ffn_residual and attn_residual lines peak at around 1400-1500 from layer 5 to 21, while ffn_output peaks similarly but drops significantly after layer 21. The attn_output line remains near 0 until layer 21, where it spikes to around 1000. Notably, ffn_residual and attn_residual have similar values and trends, as do ffn_output and attn_output, but with distinct behaviors.
raw_responses.Chinese:
The figure presents a line chart illustrating the "Massive Activation of baseline" across different layers of a model, comparing four distinct data series.

The x-axis represents the "Layer," with values ranging from 0 to 23, marked at intervals of 5, but no units are specified.

The y-axis represents the "Max Activation Value," with values ranging from 0 to 1600, marked at intervals of 200.

The chart features four lines, each representing a different series: 
- attn_output, depicted in blue and characterized by a dashed line style,
- attn_residual, depicted in orange and characterized by a dotted line style,
- ffn_output, depicted in green and characterized by a dash-dot line style,
- ffn_residual, depicted in red and characterized by a solid line style.

The lines exhibit notable patterns: 
- attn_output starts at approximately 0, remains near 0 until layer 5, then sharply increases to around 1200 at layer 21, before dropping to about 100 at layer 23.
- attn_residual starts at approximately 25, remains near 0 until layer 5, then sharply increases to around 1500 at layer 7, remains stable until layer 21, then drops to about 600 at layer 23.
- ffn_output starts at approximately 25, remains near 0 until layer 5, then sharply increases to around 1400 at layer 7, fluctuates slightly until layer 21, then drops to about 400 at layer 23.
- ffn_residual starts at approximately 25, remains near 0 until layer 5, then sharply increases to around 1500 at layer 7, remains stable until layer 21, then drops to about 500 at layer 23.

The "attn_residual" line starts at 0, sharply increases to 1400 at layer 5, remains steady until layer 20, and then drops to around 600 at layer 22. The ffn_residual series is represented by a red solid line, starting at approximately 20, sharply increasing at layer 5 to about 1500, and remaining high until around layer 21, where it sharply decreases.
